items.text: coming back from another app, the bar and its shelf lay themselves out again for the screen they are on
three fingers hide the controls only on a quick tap, never when the iPad's app-switch gesture passes through
opening the water from Pack keeps Pack beside it as a tab, so there is a way back; the sound panel shows Pack too
Water is listed once, under Playing now; the library lists only what you can add
the sound shelf's Beats · Field · Touch switch keeps its round ends when an end is lit
glass and drum sounds added before they left the library are taken off the shelf
the cover is the name and the Founders Club; the field line lives in the Guide and the colophon
the FEME Starter, the Frost Electronic Music Ensemble's water pack, is back in the library and downloadable from the pack guide
the studio's glass and drums leave the public library again, and sounds and packs can't be saved or downloaded for now
the glass and drum sets are back in the library, now that Playing now says what is sounding
the Touch ring has no off dot again; the name in the middle switches touch off and on, so only one dot is ever lit

the Guide shows Playing the field, Dimitry's own diagram: pattern shapes the field, touch disturbs and directs it, sound vibrates it, picture and video connect it to your world, and time syncs it, with a stopwatch at the center
the field line, "The field is always there. You can shape it. You can move it. You can play it, but you can never control it.", on the cover, under the diagram and in the colophon
